Sometime between [[3973 BBY]] and [[3965 BBY]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the conflict known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] '''raided''' the [[Taskeed system/Legends|Taskeed system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the region known as [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The battle in the [[Taskeed/Legends|Taskeed]] system was preceded by a [[Battle of the Sy Myrth system|victory]] for the Mandalorians in the [[Sy Myrth system/Legends|Sy Myrth system]]. Following the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] victory at Taskeed, the Mandalorians [[Battle of the Dennogra system|attacked]] the [[Dennogra system/Legends|Dennogra system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Taskeed system was referenced in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
